prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a low-speed head-on collision claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1202; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for low-speed head-on collision. Insured reports the other vehicle crossed the centerline on a curve. Both vehicles drivable from scene, minor front-end damage reported. Insured states passenger in other vehicle complained of neck pain at scene. Photos requested from insured and police report ordered.

Entry 2: Police report received. Responding officer notes both vehicles sustained front bumper and headlamp damage, no airbags deployed. Other driver cited for lane violation. Insured's statement consistent with report. Liability appears clear for the other driver's carrier to accept. Contacted the other carrier to confirm claim number and coverage limits.

Entry 3: Claimant has retained counsel. Attorney letter of representation received requesting that all communications go through their office. Claimant's medical treatment reported as ongoing, diagnosis of cervical strain. Requested itemized medical records and billing through counsel. Reserve adjusted to reflect bodily injury exposure and property damage estimate.

Entry 4: Independent appraisal completed on insured vehicle. Repair estimate reviewed and approved for bumper cover replacement, headlamp assembly, and related alignment work. Rental coverage confirmed for the repair period. Counsel's office called to ask about the status of the injury claim; advised that records are still pending and that we will respond once received.

Entry 5: Medical records received through counsel and reviewed. Treatment consists of urgent care visit, follow-up with a physical therapist, and prescribed muscle relaxants. Records show a neck strain consistent with the described impact. Injury claim referred for evaluation of settlement value. Supervisor review scheduled. File remains open pending demand package from counsel.
